name: Narrow Slits: Widely-Spaced Fringes
description: Set slits to minimum size (4 px). Narrower slits act more like ideal point sources, producing cleaner interference patterns with less diffraction blur. Observe how each slit individually radiates as a nearly perfect circular source.

successCriteria.description: Observe clean, well-defined interference fringes from narrow slits
Compare narrow (4px) vs wider (12px) slits: which produces cleaner fringes?

hints.message: Narrow slits approximate ideal point sources, producing the cleanest interference pattern.
Huygens principle: each point on a wavefront acts as a new source. Narrow slits = closer to a true point source.
